scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json

notes.three-stack: three / @react-three/fiber / @react-three/drei power the Phase 2 hero and Phase 4 technology universe. Lazy-loaded — only fetched when WebGL is available and reduced-motion is off.
notes.framer-motion: REMOVED in Phase 12. It was declared in Phase 1 but never imported — every animation is CSS-level (Tailwind keyframes) or useFrame inside the 3D scenes.
notes.server: server/index.ts serves dist/ and hosts /api/contact on one origin for Railway. It imports the same handler as the serverless deployment, so contact logic exists once.
